0:00 Will it play in tune? · 0:40 The verdict · 1:20 What's in the kit
This takes a few minutes. You can leave this page; the soundcheck keeps running.
The soundcheck starts as soon as your file finishes uploading. If you closed the page while
it was uploading, start a new soundcheck.
This video is private, so we can't watch it. Set it to Unlisted on YouTube, or upload
Empty: nothing ticked; Not a result yet
Nothing is recommended until your model is usable, but you can try any edit.
Cut list: "Tick edits to build a cut list."
loading.tsx skeleton and error.tsx as on other screens
Totals with ranges (middle 80% of 200 simulations). With edits ticked they describe the edited cut, with the
The chart shows the edited cut's predicted bands per audience; the YouTube player appears above the edit
panel only for a linked video.
EditPanel: judge by seconds watched (default) or % of the cut. Recommended edits are ticked on open;
uncertain ones are grey. Ticking waits 250 ms, then POSTs …/simulate.
CutExports: a CSV cut list (times in the cut as it is) and chapters for the edited cut, by YouTube's rules.
→ Simulate errors show in the panel: 400 "These edits can't go together", 409 "isn't ready for edits yet"
